nl: Run the unit tests of the project in geometry/ (python -m unittest discover -s tests, run inside geometry/) and name the failing tests.
oracle_program: test.run "geometry" framework: unittest |> filter status == "failed" |> select name
reference_pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
Set-Location geometry; & $py -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" } | Select-String '\.\.\. (FAIL|ERROR)$'
